postil.definition:
n. Originally, an explanatory note in the margin of the Bible,
   so called because written after the text; hence, a marginal note; a
   comment.
n. A short homily or commentary on a passage of Scripture; as,
   the first postils were composed by order of Charlemagne.
v. t. To write marginal or explanatory notes on; to gloss.
v. i. To write postils, or marginal notes; to comment; to
   postillate.
postil.translation:
n. 批注, 注释
[经] 旁注, 注解

postiled.translation: n. (基督教《圣经》的)旁注；批注；注解；评注

postiler.definition:
n. One who writers marginal notes; one who illustrates the
   text of a book by notes in the margin.
postiler.translation: n. (基督教《圣经》的)旁注；批注；注解；评注

postiling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Postil
postiling.translation: n. (基督教《圣经》的)旁注；批注；注解；评注
